messages:
alex: Heads-up — multiple customer dashboards show per-model throughput as zero starting ~02:15 UTC. Happens across regions. Suspect it lines up with the exporter relabel change we rolled last night. Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshots/abc123 :eyes:
marie: Can you drop the exact Prometheus query used by the panels? Also which dashboard and panel id?
dan: I think the exporter changed the label key from `model` -> `model_name` in that deploy. Panels querying `by (model)` would collapse to an empty series.
alex: Panel is "Per-model QPS" (dashboard id 42, panel 7). Query from panel:
```
sum(rate(redwood_inference_model_qps_total{job="model_exporter"}[5m])) by (model)
```
jen: Confirmed — deploy bot shows the relabel PR merged at 01:58 UTC, rollout completed 02:05 UTC (link: https://deploys/redwood/567). oncall-bot: @eng-platform deployed model-exporter/1.12.0 to prod at 01:58:42.
dan: Quick repro locally: exporter now emits `model_name` label instead of `model`. Prometheus stores metrics with the emitted label, so the `by (model)` grouping returns empty set.
kevin: Two actionable fixes: 1) update dashboards to use `model_name` OR 2) add a Prometheus relabeling/recording rule that copies `model_name`->`model` so existing queries keep working.
marie: Customer-facing fix ASAP — can we do a compatibility rule in Prometheus while we update dashboards and the exporter emits both labels?
jen: I can add a recording rule to the shared prometheus cluster. Suggest rule:
```
- record: redwood_inference_model_qps_by_model
  expr: sum(rate(redwood_inference_model_qps_total{job="model_exporter"}[5m])) by (model_name)
  labels:
    model: "${1}"  # placeholder, see note
```
But simpler: relabel in scrape config to add `model` label from `model_name` with `relabel_configs`.
dan: Example relabel snippet to add before ingestion (scrape config):
```
- source_labels: [__name__, model_name]
  regex: (redwood_inference_model_qps_total);(.+)
  target_label: model
  replacement: $2
```
kevin: That looks fine — but watch cardinality if something else emits model_name differently.
alex: Customers asking — ETA?
jen: I can push the relabel tweak to the prometheus cluster in ~15m (will test in canary). After that dashboards should populate.
marie: I'll message affected customers with a short note: "We identified a metrics label change as root cause; temporary compat fix being applied; dashboards will reappear shortly."
kevin: After prom rule live, we should open a follow-up to standardize on `model_name` across dashboards and to vendor a dual-emission policy on exporter. Also add an entry to the release notes. :memo:
jen: Patch applied to prom-canary, graphs in canary now show series again. Rolling to prod in 10m. :shipit:
marie: Thanks team. Please paste the prom config change and the dashboards that need updating here so I can track the follow-up.
alex: Will attach the diffs and a small runbook for this class of relabel regressions.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0456 | Metrics: per-model QPS blank after exporter label rename. Assigned to eng-platform.
kevin: Closing loop — recordfull fix: exporter will start emitting `model` AND `model_name` in next patch; dashboards updated to prefer `model_name`. Temporary prom relabeling will be removed after 2 weeks.
marie: Great. Marking this as resolved once prod prom change finishes and customers confirm. :white_check_mark:
